memory.content: Source of truth is https://github.com/parolkar/SmallPE. Keep a local clone; prefer reading clone files over memory; refresh via weekday smallpe-skillset-sync and stay quiet when nothing changed.

Prefer Grok Task executors that start by reading agents/<name>/CLAUDE.md (+ templates) for specialist passes; Managing Partner orchestrates and owns IC Supporting Analysis & FAQ; light inline skillset enrichment is ok for short asks; never use bin/start_agentic_team or claude-swarm.
Boot order from the clone: soul.md, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, self-narrative.md, agents/shared-tools.md, then relevant memory journals/capsules.

routines.name: smallpe-skillset-sync
routines.description: Weekday morning pull of the local SmallPE clone; report skillset/persona diffs only.
routines.content:
Pull the local SmallPE clone (clone https://github.com/parolkar/SmallPE if missing, else git pull --ff-only). Diff skillset-relevant paths only: agents/managing-partner.md, .cursor-plugin/plugin.json, and agentic-team-for-private-equity/{soul.md,CLAUDE.md,AGENTS.md,self-narrative.md,agents/**}. If anything material changed in those paths, summarize the changes for the user in a few bullets. If nothing changed, send no message — stay quiet, no filler. Schedule: 15 8 * * 1-5 (weekdays 8:15 local).

Fires on:
- cron `15 8 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
